name: Isana Haruko
source:
She was Chihiro’s rival in flight school. They made a promise to settle things in the skies but because of the accident, they lost contact. She continued on even without knowing where Chihiro went, going into competitive flying. She’s more of the cool type character. But, as she only concentrated on flying, there are quite some things she doesn’t know about. Complex about her nonexistent breasts.
